newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila Mayor offered "love potion" to seduce flies.
newsitem.headline: Manila Mayor offered "love potion" to seduce flies.

text.p: Manila's mayor Alfredo Lim, who has launched a drive to rid the city of flies after a cholera outbreak, has been told that a "magic love potion" is the best way to seduce and slay flies, the Manila Times newspaper said.
The offer of a fly trap which uses female fly secretions to lure male flies was given to Lim by a community service group, the Times said in a front page report on Friday.
It quoted a Lim aide as saying the trap uses a substance the female fly secretes while having sex.

Flies lured into the fly trap are killed electrically and if enough male flies die, females flies will not have mates and eventually Mayor Lim's campaign to eradicate flies will succeed, the report said.
Lim recently blamed flies and cockroaches for the death of seven people in a cholera outbreak in Manila and offered cash to residents who captured the insects.

Officials paid fly-catchers 15 pesos (about six U.S. cents) for each bag of 10 flies or 10 cockroaches which were later burned. Lim said he would pay bigger money -- 20 centavos (about eight cents) -- for a rat.
